snippets.BOOKWORM_THECHRONICLER_100: And he did all that in...let me quickly look it up...

snippets.BOOKWORM_THECHRONICLER_98: Ah, that's right! Paul...Paul the Kid.

snippets.BRUNO_THECHRONICLER_61: Alors. Maybe you'll be hungry after I tell you what I know.

snippets.BRUNO_THECHRONICLER_70: Real food must be prepared properly, in a real kitchen. Not in a kiosk!
snippets.BRUNO_THECHRONICLER_71: In a kitchen like ours. Would you maybe like some fries?
snippets.BRUNO_THECHRONICLER_72: I believe the Pandas in that Bitterland ate pancakes and Paul the Kid smelled that.

snippets.BRUNO_THECHRONICLER_76: No time? Later then, yes? See you!
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_03: I don't like to be disturbed, $$name$$. Apart from that, I have a lot to do.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_05: Did you come here to help me, $$name$$?

snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_09: What's that? You're asking what a Chronicler is?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_11: We don't actively make history, we just put it in writing.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_12: If, for example, the Smashing Pancakes give a concert, we record all the details.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_13: Where they play, when they play, which songs they play and so on and so forth.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_14: So you can see, I've got my Panda paws full!
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_15: And Panfu isn't exactly a quiet and peaceful place these days either, is it, $$name$$?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_16: Kamaria - in all her wisdom - has charged me with the task of writing down the history of the old Panfu.

snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_163: Please help me answer the following questions.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_165: Let's see if the story makes sense now.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_166: Thank you very much for your help, $$name$$.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_167: I have received our painter's pictures.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_168: They are breathtaking, but I'm afraid they have been all mixed up.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_169: Since you have seen them before, could you help me put them in the right order?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_17: You do remember the old Panfu, don't you, $$name$$?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_170: Thank you, $$name$$. Let's see if they make sense in this order now.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_170_A: Thank you very, very much for helping me, $$name$$.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_171: You may keep the Quest Book.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_172: I have the feeling that you'll be writing the next chapters of Panda history!
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_173: And if there should be any rumours about new quests, you'll find them logged in your Quest Book.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_174: If you take part in any of these quests, your Quest Book will always keep you up to date on your progress.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_175: You can take another look at what has happened so far and everything you do will be automatically logged, similar to a journal.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_177: Maybe you'll even visit the mysterious Bitterland.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_178: Have a closer look at the Quest Book tomorrow.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_179: Rumour has it that Max is planning something...
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_18: No?! Do you see the painting on the wall over there? It will refresh your memory.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_180: Goodbye, $$name$$ and thanks for your help!
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_19: You see, Panfu used to be half the size it is today.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_20: Today we also have the dark land in the north. It is known as...

snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_23: I'll admit, it does look dark, dull and grey, but sad Pandas? Is something like that even possible?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_24: Nobody has ventured to this part of the island yet.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_25: Evron is the ruler of Bitterland. At least that's what Kamaria tells us. But she doesn't reveal anything apart from that.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_26: That's a strange story, isn't it, $$name$$?
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_27: This Bitterland has neither feet, nor can it swim. Yet it managed to bind itself to Panfu, as if by magic.
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_28: If there is any truth to the rumours, then it was Paul the Kid's magic!
snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_32: Even though I have seen all this with my very own eyes, I am still missing a few pieces to this historic puzzle.

snippets.CHRONICLER_THECHRONICLER_39: Good luck, $$name$$! I'm counting on you.
